title: 第654章 一吞化万身第653章 幽火玄岩狈
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
那些纹师正笑得猖狂，忽然只觉得脑袋一沉，识海像被灌了铅，神念运转瞬间滞涩了数倍。
而那老者更是喷出一口鲜血，身前的图纹光芒骤暗，连用来维持幽火玄岩狈出现的神念都变得吃力起来。
“这..我的神念怎么运转这么慢？”
“那个人做了什么？？”
“这是何等诡异神通？”
感受到神念运转慢了足足五成，焚宇部纹师顿时慌了神。
这代表他们释放图纹的速度也会慢一倍，面对一些触手速度快的敌人，对于纹师来说，这可是相当致命的。
“嘿嘿嘿，谢了大哥！”
秦小四咧嘴一笑，身形骤然消失。
驺吾图腾全力展开，奔跑之中，众人只能看到空气中，好似有一道彩色的残影，瞬移般在纹师群里穿梭。
“踏影分踪！！！”
腿影翻飞，纹师们只听到一声声骨裂声接连响起，随后自己就如同一个破麻袋般飞出去，这时才知道自己胸口内的骨头已然全部碎掉。
不过数息功夫，纹师们便倒了一小半。
维持拓片的老者惊呼道：“快拦住他！别让他靠近我等！！”
他刚说完，就感觉一股清风扑面而来，再一眨眼，秦小四的脸已然出现在他面前。
“你在找我吗？”秦小四嘿嘿一笑，露出一个十分阳光的笑容。
老者瞳孔骤缩，心中大惊，拼尽全力催动神念。、
可神念被秦大川压制着，像陷入泥沼，慢得离谱。护身图纹才亮起半道虚影，秦小四的扫腿已经抽在了他腰腹之间。
噗嗤！
骨裂与筋断的脆响混在一起，老者整个人像被巨斧拦腰劈中，从腰腹处齐齐断开。

上半身打着旋飞出去丈远，鲜血混着内脏泼洒了一地，落在焦黑的泥土上，刺目得很。
周遭纹师吓得魂飞魄散，纷纷倒吸冷气。
这可是族里的宙级纹师，肉身虽不如专职战士，也有法象境的底蕴。
此刻，竟被一个看起来半大的少年一脚活活劈成两半？这腿力到底恐怖到了什么地步！
秦小四收腿落地，咧嘴一笑，露出一口白牙。
“你这速度也太慢了点吧。”
半截身子落在地上的老者还没断气，他撑着胳膊，咳着血沫子抬头看秦小四，忽然发出嗬嗬的惨笑，血水顺着嘴角往下淌。
“你以为……杀了我就赢了？”
他眼神怨毒地瞟向不远处的幽火玄岩狈，声音嘶哑道：“你错了！没了我的神念压制，这畜牲只会更疯。你们...全都得给我陪葬！哈哈哈哈！”
秦小四脸色微变，猛地转头望去，果不其然，失去神念牵引的幽火玄岩狈发出一声震耳欲聋的暴戾嘶吼。
原本被约束的凶性彻底爆发，兽瞳红得快要滴出血来，周身幽火暴涨数尺，漆黑的岩甲上都窜起了火苗。
它胡乱挥着巨爪，周遭岩壁被拍得碎石乱飞，地面被刨出数丈深的坑，连靠近的几名焚宇纹师都被一爪子拍飞，惨叫着摔成了肉泥。
这畜牲彻底失了控，见着活物就扑，凶性比方才盛了数倍。
“嘶...有点麻烦了啊。”
秦小四挠了挠头，刚要动身，眼角余光瞥见一道熟悉的身影从后方走来，眼睛顿时亮了。
content_en:
The tattoo masters were laughing wildly when suddenly they felt their heads sinking, their sea of ​​consciousness seemed to be filled with lead, and their spiritual thoughts were instantly stagnant several times.
The old man spat out a mouthful of blood, and the pattern in front of him dimmed suddenly, and even the spiritual thought used to maintain the appearance of the ghostly fire basalt became laborious.
"Why... why is my spiritual mind running so slowly?"
"What did that person do??"
"What kind of weird magical power is this?"
Feeling that the movement of his spiritual thoughts was slowed down by a full 50%, the tattoo master of the Fenyu Department suddenly panicked.
This means that the speed at which they release patterns will be twice as slow. Facing some enemies with fast tentacles, this is quite fatal for tattoo masters.
"Hehehe, thank you, brother!"
Qin Xiaosi grinned and disappeared suddenly.
The Zuowu totem was fully deployed, and while running, everyone could only see a colorful afterimage in the air, moving through the group of tattoo masters like a teleport.
"Step on the shadow to separate the traces!!!"
The shadow of the legs flew, and the tattoo artists heard a series of bone cracking sounds, and then they flew out like a broken sack. Only then did they realize that all the bones in their chests had been shattered.
In just a few breaths, the tattoo masters were down by less than half.
The old man who maintained the rubbings exclaimed: "Stop him quickly! Don't let him get close to me!!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he felt a breeze blowing against his face, and in the blink of an eye, Qin Xiaosi's face appeared in front of him.
"Are you looking for me?" Qin Xiaosi chuckled, showing a very sunny smile.
The old man's pupils shrank suddenly, he was frightened, and he tried his best to activate his spiritual thoughts. ,
But his spiritual thoughts were suppressed by Qin Dachuan, as if he was stuck in a quagmire, and was ridiculously slow. The protective pattern was only half-lighted, and Qin Xiaosi's sweeping leg had already hit him between the waist and abdomen.
Poof!
The crisp sounds of cracked bones and broken tendons were mixed together. The old man's entire figure was struck in the waist by a giant axe, and was severed from the waist and abdomen.
The upper body spun and flew a few feet away. The blood mixed with the internal organs splashed all over the floor and landed on the charred soil, which was very dazzling.
The tattoo masters around him were so frightened that they all gasped.
This is the Zhou-level tattoo master in the clan. Although his physical body is not as good as that of a full-time warrior, he still has the foundation of the Dharma Realm.
At this moment, he was actually split in half by a kick from a boy who looked half his age? How terrifying is this leg strength!
Qin Xiaosi retracted his legs and landed on the ground, grinning, showing his white teeth.
"Your speed is too slow."
The old man, half of his body lying on the ground, was still breathing. He held up his arms, coughed up blood and looked up at Qin Xiaosi. He suddenly let out a horrifying laugh, and blood dripped down the corners of his mouth.
"You think...you will win if you kill me?"
He glanced at the Youhuo Xuanyan not far away with malicious eyes, and said in a hoarse voice: "You are wrong! Without my divine will to suppress it, this beast will only become crazier. You...all have to be buried with me! Hahahaha!"
Qin Xiaosi's expression changed slightly, and he suddenly turned his head to look. As expected, Youhuo Xuanyan, who had lost the pull of his spiritual thoughts, let out a deafening violent roar.
The originally restrained ferocity completely exploded, the beast's pupils were so red that they were about to bleed, and the ghostly fire around him surged several feet, and flames burst out from the dark rock armor.
It waved its huge claws indiscriminately, causing rubble to fly from the surrounding rock walls, and a pit several feet deep was dug out on the ground. Even several Fenyu Pattern Masters who were close to it were knocked away by a claw, and they screamed and fell into a pulp.
This beast was completely out of control. It pounced on any living thing it saw, and its ferocity was several times greater than before.
"Hey...it's a bit troublesome."
Qin Xiaosi scratched his head and was about to start when he saw a familiar figure coming from behind from the corner of his eye, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
